Which One Is Different? Rules

Several cards are alike in one way - except one. Tap the card that does not belong.

The rules

The goal
A game has 6 rounds. In each round you see a few cards. All of them but one have something in common: they are from the same group of things, or they have the same shape, the same filling or the same number of shapes. Tap the card that is different. Then tap Next.
Right and wrong
The right card gets a double frame. A wrong card is crossed out and you can try another one. There is no time limit; only the mistakes are counted.
Levels
Easy: four drawings, three of them from the same group (animals, vehicles, plants or things at home). Medium: five cards; some rounds show drawings, others show shapes that differ in one feature, while one more feature changes from card to card. Hard: six cards, and two features change from card to card, so you must find the feature that is the same for all but one.
Hint
The hint marks the odd card. A game with a hint counts as solved all the same.

Example

Three circles and one square: the square is different, because the others are all circles.
